production/image-demand/image-s01-02-v1/.observation: Style frame: warm sunset at right, dense black mangrove ink, amber water, close foreground woman and child. Its sunset is not the moonless time required for this shot.

Existing candidate: elevated wide of three canoes from lower-left to upper-right; four people in lead, three in middle, four in rear. Cool dark water, warm edge accents, rear children have blue chest/neck accents.

Neighbor S01-03: Amaia at right with sleeping child, braid and round pendant; Yara left with wrapped object, Dairon cropped left; ghost elder behind. Same cool mangrove water and amber gunwale accents.
Historical Amaia proposal: athletic young woman with curly low ponytail, white one-shoulder wrap, rust skirt, no pendant. Candidate instead has braid/pendant and light skirt; proposal is unapproved.
Historical Dairon proposal: strongly muscular man with curled low ponytail, white shoulder wrap and rust skirt; long wood paddle. Candidate has multiple braids, jewelry and pale lower garment.

Historical Yara proposal: broad sturdy woman, long single braid, white sleeveless top, orange skirt and large gray bundle. Candidate Yara is slender, loose-haired, with earrings and a small carved object visible in cloth.

Historical Beheto proposal: lean elderly clean-shaven man, tied gray hair, white sleeveless wrap and charcoal skirt, large rope drum. Candidate has short white hair, white beard and mustache, smaller drum.

checks.identity: Staging identifies Dairon, Yara, Amaia with son, and Beheto provisionally. Amaia resembles S01-03 through face, braid and pendant. Historical sheets conflict: Dairon braid/jewelry versus curly ponytail; Yara slender loose-haired versus sturdy single braid; Beheto bearded short-haired versus clean-shaven tied-back gray hair. Original pencil portraits required by STORY_FRAME tier 1 are unavailable in the packet; docs/STATUS.md records them as missing. Exact likeness cannot be certified. Three rear children and three additional passengers lack individual identity references.
checks.costume: Candidate uses worn cream cotton wraps and necklaces/arm bands; Amaia has circular pendant. Historical rust/orange/charcoal skirts are not reproduced. Current bible controls over these unapproved proposals: Amaia is 26 and gaunt with wet tied-back black hair, Dairon about 30 lean and hard, Yara about 20. Candidate Amaia is not clearly gaunt; exact adult ages and 22-month toddler age are not verifiable from this wide view. No modern clothing is evident.
checks.props_and_contact: Three rigid dugout hulls are readable. Dairon grips one straight paddle with both hands, right hand higher at screen-left and left hand lower near frame center; blade contacts foreground water. This is visible pose, not a canonical handedness lock. Yara supports a wrapped carved object against chest but a decorated top protrudes, weakening the stiff-cloth enclosure. Amaia supports sleeping child across her lap and ribs. Beheto has drum between knees with hands at head; flat-palm contact is ambiguous at this scale. Rear paddlers have coherent paddle silhouettes; hidden grips and toddler hands cannot be certified.
checks.composition: Elevated wide follows a diagonal single-file procession from upper-right toward lower-left. Lead canoe dominates lower-left; middle canoe sits center-right; rear canoe upper-right. Mangrove roots frame left, overhead leaves and large foreground right roots supply depth. Hull bows and paddle blade remain visible with narrow lower-edge margin. This one frame suggests a crane-down field, not a completed camera move. Actual PNG is 1672x941, approximately 16:9 but not exact (width*9=15048 versus height*16=15056); preserved without cropping.
checks.lighting: Moonless-looking navy/steel channel, charcoal canopy and warm copper highlights on faces/gunwales; no visible moon or sunset. Matches night script more closely than sunset reference 01. Warm key reads from upper-left/front but its physical source is offscreen and unconfirmed. Blue effect reads prominently on rear children chests/necks rather than faintly restricted to forearms.
checks.line_and_color: Variable black contours, scratchy wood grain, fine garment folds, grouped dark hair and painterly foliage/water provide a finished textured 2D frame. Warm brown skin survives cool environment. Faces are relatively smooth and anime-shaped; fidelity to original asymmetric pencil geometry remains unverified. No text, watermark or speech bubble is visible.
checks.neighbor_continuity: S01-03 repeats lead order, Amaia braid/pendant, sleeping child, Yara bundle and night palette. Ghost seats belong to S01-03 and are appropriately absent here. S01-01 has no supplied image; black water and paddle link are script-only. Reference 01 is a sunset style anchor and is not a time-of-day continuity authority.
checks.script_fidelity: Three canoes, lead Dairon/Yara/Amaia/son, middle Beheto/drum and three rear children read as requested. Eleven visible people accord with S01-03 count: four lead, three middle, four rear. The three additional companions are not individually specified in S01-02; their identities/designs require a cast lock rather than invented names. Child glow placement and exposed cemi need review. Single flattened still provides no five-layer separation, breathing, paddle cycle, crane move, sound or 288-frame action coverage. Timing retained as frames 360 through 647, end boundary 648 at 24 fps.
